title: Refund Policy
seoDescription: Learn how to request help with a SemrushGroupBuy purchase and where to check the refund terms that apply to your order.

sections.heading: Before you purchase
sections.text: Check the refund eligibility, time limits, renewal details, and cancellation conditions shown by the payment provider at checkout. Those terms determine what applies to your specific order.

sections.heading: Requesting assistance
sections.text: If access does not work as described, contact our support team with your order reference, purchase date, the affected tool, and a description of the issue. Do not send passwords or full card details.

sections.heading: Refund review
sections.text: Support will review your request against the terms applicable to the purchase and any relevant consumer protections. Submitting a request does not guarantee a refund. We do not advertise a fixed refund window here without verified merchant terms.

sections.heading: Contact support
sections.text: Use the WhatsApp support link below to request help or ask about refund eligibility before placing an order.
